{{Map Embed|Jinzhou|Fucan}}

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} Such a strange name. Nobody around here goes by that...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Fucan:''' There's always these weird names on packages, making deliveries a real puzzle...
:'''Fucan:''' Can you believe there's someone named "Ms. Vera's Dog"?
:'''Fucan:''' Well, at least it's a living thing. Then there's "Liv's Quilted Coat". How's a coat supposed to receive a package?
:'''Fucan:''' And this one, "Universe's Strongest Chief". We've got [[Midnight Rangers]] and Patrollers, but no chiefs. What's that about? There's no such position in the Ministry of War.
:{{DIcon}} ...Maybe they're from another universe.
:{{DIcon}} Is it from a famous Hero Play?
:'''Fucan:''' Sorry, no time for jokes now. Got a package to deliver, pronto.
:'''Fucan:''' Maybe... It's been ages since I watched a Hero Play. Work's been non-stop.
:'''Fucan:''' Anyway, enough chatter. Time to hustle and get these packages where they need to be.
:'''Fucan:''' Can't afford to mess up our reputation as "We Promise, We Deliver".
{{Dialogue End}}
